tags.label: Instructions
tags.definition: Text that tells the model how to behave.

tags.label: Context
tags.definition: Text that hands the model information about its situation.

tags.label: User-turn templates
tags.definition: Text written into the user's turn on the user's behalf.

tags.label: Tool descriptions
tags.definition: Text that describes a tool the model can call.

tags.label: Parameter descriptions
tags.definition: Text that describes one argument of a tool call.

tags.label: Shipped in several places
tags.definition: The same text appears in more than one bundle or offset.
